parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The rule description. The maximum length is 500 characters.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether the rule is enabled.

parameters.name: ErrorHandlers
parameters.description: The list of issue handlers for data quality rule verification.

sub_parameters.name: ErrorDataFilter
sub_parameters.description: For a custom SQL rule, you must specify the SQL used to filter problematic data.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The rule name. The name can be a combination of digits, English letters, Chinese characters, and half-width or full-width punctuation. The maximum length is 255 characters.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Settings page to obtain the workspace ID.

parameters.name: SamplingConfig
parameters.description: The settings required for sample collection.

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.description:
The severity level of the rule for the business (corresponding to strong/weak rules on the page). Valid values:
- Normal
- High

parameters.name: TemplateCode
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the rule template referenced by the rule.
